text:
irene_ops: Heads up — starting canary warmup for v2 on eu-west1 in ~10m. Deploybot scheduled at 2026-03-21T10:10Z. Expect brief spike in p95 from ~20ms -> ~80ms. No client pins currently; draft release notes at /docs/releases/2026-03-v2-warmup (edit-only).
deploybot: Canary warmup queued. Preflight checks: model-compat, header-sanitizer, client-timeout-override. ETA ~4m. preflight_status=warning/0/errors/0.
sam_sre: re: client-timeouts — we saw a mobile client timeout regression at ~70ms in last internal test. Can we add a 2s client-backoff for mobile routes just for the warmup? @irene_ops
alice_dev: I pushed a tiny gateway shim that lowercases Version header for canary traffic. Image tag: v2-canary-20260321. No model/schema change, just header normalization.
ben_release: Release notes draft: call out header case normalization + recommend SDK bump. Also adding rollback steps. Can someone proofread the customer-facing blurb? I'll wait before publishing.
irene_ops: @sam_sre adding route-level timeout override: /mobile/* => 3s for the warmup. I'll push the routing change when deploybot confirms preflight.
sam_sre: thanks. Also request we create a metric to watch: gateway.header_case_mismatch.count so we can alert if normalization causes client errors.
deploybot: Preflight result: OK with one warning. Warning: client-probe failures=3 (rate limited). Suggestion: slowstart 3m instead of 1m to reduce initial probe pressure. To apply: `deploybot slowstart 3m`.
irene_ops: Agree with slowstart 3m. Applying now.
alice_dev: operator snippet to run if helpful:
```shell
# apply slowstart for canary
deploybot set --canary v2-canary-20260321 --slowstart 3m
```
ben_release: Added customer advice: "If you see increased 504s, revert header normalization or pin to v1 via header `X-API-Version: 1`." Putting that in the rollback section.
sam_sre: quick question — what's our rollback window for this cutover? 30m default. I'd prefer 45m given mobile uncertainty.
irene_ops: Extending rollback window to 45m and updating release checklist. Alerting thresholds: if error rate >5% sustained for 5m -> auto rollback. I'll ping #eng-oncall if threshold trips.
ben_release: lgtm. I'll finish the notes, run a quick spellcheck, and email the changelog to customers after 1h if warmup stays stable :thumbsup:
